# Remove received Brain executables from the Engine

## Context

This is Wave 3's terminal Neo-side PR. It may open only after source/package receive, deployment/image receive, tracker conversion, day-one Brain CI, skill/enforcement substrate, peer-owned learn/ADR migration, and the cut manifest's removal predicate are all green at pinned heads.

## The Problem

Deleting earlier makes rollback and completeness unprovable. Deleting later without cleaning scripts/dependencies/hooks/package/public surfaces leaves a mixed Engine that still carries Brain authority.

## The Architectural Reality

- ADR 0040 keeps `src/ai/**`, Fleet Manager keeper surfaces, Engine apps, Engine contracts/clients, and Engine-facing tests by subject; moving/staying follows the cut manifest, not the `ai` token alone.
- Engine never depends on the Brain package, including devDependencies.
- #17783 owns hook/CI custody and trigger/binding receipts; **#17798** owns the public skill substrate (#17784 closed and superseded when the transport became an npm dependency).
- Brain receive and image proofs are the preconditions; Wave 4 owns severe continuity after the cut.

## The Fix

Open one terminal PR against `neomjs/neo:dev` that removes exactly the cut-manifest mover set, retires/rewrites root scripts and package entries, sheds Brain package/deployment artifacts, preserves every stay-Engine subject, and proves Engine-only clone/build/test/onboarding with the Brain available only as an externally provisioned runtime for the whitebox tier.

The PR is human-merge-gated after the Brain receive PRs, tracker transfer, and peer learn/ADR work merge.

## Contract Ledger Matrix

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Neo mover paths | cut manifest | absent after removal, exact set | any residue/missing stay path blocks | migration ledger | target/source diff |
| Engine package/scripts | ADR 0040 | no Brain deps/devDeps/scripts; Engine release remains valid | no Brain fallback | package docs | pack/build/script census |
| stay-Engine AI surfaces | ADR 0040 + subject census | `src/ai`, Fleet Manager keeper surfaces, apps/contracts/client/tests remain by subject | accidental deletion blocks | Architecture docs | identity receipt |
| whitebox tier | ADR 0040 §2.3/§2.5 | external pinned runtime via distinct roots | absent binding fails loud | test guide | swap/omit negative controls |
| cut completion | D#17782 | received Brain heads verified before removal | rollback/revert; no merge | runway receipt | cross-repo gate read |

## Decision Record impact

`aligned-with amended ADR 0040`; `depends-on ADR 0019` for retired/moved config and #17783 for enforcement custody.

## Decision Record

Required: consume the final ADR 0040 amendment; this PR is its terminal execution receipt.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every cut-manifest mover is absent from Neo and present at the pinned verified Brain head; no extra deletion or source/target residue.
- [ ] Every stay-Engine identity remains, including `src/ai/**`, Fleet Manager keeper surfaces, Engine apps, public contracts/clients, and subject-owned tests/guards.
- [ ] Root scripts, package manifests/locks, `.npmignore`, exports, docs/build references, hooks, and workflows match Engine-only custody.
- [ ] Neo has zero dependency or devDependency on `neo-agent-brain` and zero relative import into the removed implementation.
- [ ] #17783 binding/trigger receipts are green at their merged heads, and **#17798**'s npm-transport receipts are green at theirs. *(Truth-synced 2026-08-26: this AC said "#17784 substrate receipts". #17784 is **closed and superseded** by #17798 — the transport changed from committed bytes to an npm dependency, so the receipt class changed with it.)*
- [ ] **The package-reference contract is discharged before this PR merges** — [#17798 comment 5425965214](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/17798#issuecomment-5425965214): no vendored guide tree; the census-split docs references URL-qualify (**13 Brain / 5 Engine**); write globs stay trigger-scoped. Concretely, **`neo-agent-skills` ≥ `0.1.2` is published and every consumer lockfile resolves it** — `0.1.2` does not exist at the time of writing (`dist-tags.latest` is `0.1.1`), so this is a live upstream precondition on #17798, not a checkbox this ticket can satisfy alone. **Rationale, so it is not read as ceremony:** the shipped package points into a `learn/` tree it does not contain, and this removal is what makes those pointers resolve nowhere instead of only-in-neo.
- [ ] Brain source/package and deployment/image receive PRs are merged and verified; tracker ledger is complete; peer learn/ADR migration is merged.
- [ ] No open PR or active A2A lane targets removed paths at the final pre-merge recheck.
- [ ] Engine-only fresh clone + install + build + unit/component/non-Neural-Link e2e + package dry-run pass without Brain source.
- [ ] Cross-repository whitebox tier uses explicit distinct `agentosRuntimeRoot` / `targetRepoRoot`; swapped/omitted bindings fail without cwd recovery.
- [ ] Source provenance, redirects, ADR/Architecture docs, and D#17782 Wave-3 receipt are current.
- [ ] Rollback instructions name the Wave-0 image pin + named verified bundle and the exact revert/receive heads; agent performs no merge.
- [ ] Post-merge Wave 4 remains required; this PR does not claim severe runtime continuity.

## Out of Scope

- Brain receive/deploy implementation;
- tracker triage or transfers;
- peer-owned learn/ADR migration;
- Wave-4 severe test and final production re-point;
- Engine feature refactors unrelated to removal;
- history rewrite.

## Avoided Traps

- **Delete to discover imports:** too late.
- **`ai/**` blanket removal:** deletes stays-Engine/subject-owned surfaces.
- **Engine devDependency on Brain:** restores the monorepo through npm.
- **Same-cwd whitebox fallback:** hides root authority bugs.
- **Merge before tracker/CI receipts:** strands both people and enforcement.
- **Call removal “the split complete”:** Wave 4 remains.

## Consumer-edge reach census — and one class the census's edge list cannot see

@neo-gpt-emmy's census ([brain#10, `60e5f74af64f`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-brain/issues/10#issuecomment-5425664290)) states its `knownConsumerEdges` are known-not-exhaustive and routes complete repointing here. Ran it against the full tracked tree at `aeed7ee52c`.

### The reach, by consumer class

`git grep` over all 25,194 tracked files outside `learn/agentos/`, restricted to lines naming one of the **111 move-to-brain** rows: **2,889 reference lines**. Of the 111 moving files, **110 are referenced from outside**. By referencing-file class:

| class | files | disposition |
|---|---:|---|
| `resources/content/**` (Portal/SEO mirrors) | 1,073 | generated — regenerate or repoint, not hand-edited |
| `ai/**` | 56 | leaves with the Brain anyway; self-resolving |
| `test/**` | 24 | follows its subject per §2.7's test rule |
| **`.agents/skills/**`** | **19** | ⚠️ **see below — this one crosses repositories** |
| `.github/` (workflows + `AI_QUICK_START`, `WORKING_WITH_AGENTS`) | 6 | Engine-staying, needs repointing |
| root (`AGENTS.md`, `README.md`, `ROADMAP.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `AGENTS_STARTUP.md`) | 5 | Engine-staying, high visibility |
| `learn/**` (other guides) | 3 | Engine-staying |
| `src/` + `apps/` (JSDoc) | 2 | Engine-staying |

**33 distinct Engine-staying files** need repointing, excluding the generated mirrors. That is #17791's hand-editable set, and it is small enough to do file-by-file.

### ⚠️ The class the edge list cannot reach: the skills package ships these pointers to OTHER repositories

`neo-agent-skills@0.1.1` publishes `files: [".agents/skills", …]` — so **the entire skill tree ships as an npm package** to `neo`, `neo-agent-brain`, and `devindex`, and to any fork that installs it.

The shipped tree references **19 distinct `learn/agentos/**` paths. 13 of them move to the Brain**:

```
DreamPipeline.md · ModelStats.md · v13-path.md
decisions/0001-cross-process-cache-coherence.md · decisions/0002-phase3-wake-substrate-standards-alignment.md
measurements/cognitive-load-baseline-2026-05.md · measurements/pr-review-baseline-2026-04.md
process/contract-ledger.md · process/correction-culture.md · process/evidence-ladder.md · process/reference-hygiene.md
tooling/Tier2RevalidationSweep.md · wake-substrate/NightShiftLeasedDriver.md
```

Concretely: **`.agents/skills/pull-request/SKILL.md:3`** — the skill's own load directive — points at `learn/agentos/process/evidence-ladder.md`, which moves.

**And the class is already live, before any file moves.** Measured against `devindex` today, which installed the package this morning:

```
devindex : learn/agentos/process/evidence-ladder.md        → 404 ABSENT
devindex : learn/agentos/ProgressiveDisclosureSkills.md    → 404 ABSENT
```

So a consumer that is *not* `neo` already receives skills whose payload pointers dangle — 19 of them, both the moving and the staying halves, because **neither half exists in a consumer's tree**. The move does not create this; it enlarges it from "resolves only in neo" to "resolves only in the Brain", and it does so for every fork the operator's goal 5 promises a clean `git clone` + `npm install`.

### What I am and am not claiming

- **Claiming:** the 33-file Engine-staying repoint set, measured; and that the shipped skill tree carries 19 cross-repo-dangling `learn/agentos` pointers, 13 of which change target under the census.
- **Not claiming:** that this blocks the census (it does not — the census is correct and its scope is custody), or that I know the right fix. Relative links out of a package into a sibling repo's docs have several possible answers (URL-ify to the canonical repo, vendor the referenced payloads, drop the pointers to prose), and picking one is a transport decision on **#17798**'s surface, not a removal decision on mine.
- **Not moving anything.** This is reach evidence for #17791 and a routed finding for #17798.

Method: `git grep -nIE "learn/agentos/[A-Za-z0-9_/.-]+\.md"` over all tracked files excluding `learn/agentos`, intersected against the census's `move-to-brain` rows by exact path. Full tree, not a sample — an earlier 4,000-file pass was discarded as a truncated sweep rather than reported.

| 8 | `npm-script-entrypoint-lint` | `lint-npm-script-entrypoints.mjs` — Brain | Engine root scripts / entrypoints | **② restore caller** |
| 9 | `retry-bound-classification-lint` | `lint-retry-bounds.mjs` — Brain, exposed as `ai:lint-retry-bounds` | Engine `src/` + `apps/` | **② restore caller** |
| 10 | `identity-engine-coherence-lint` | `lint-identity-engine-coherence.mjs` — Brain | the public Engine ModelStats document | **② restore caller** |
| 11 | `discussion-lifecycle-audit` | `audit-discussion-lifecycle.mjs` — Brain | Engine ideation skill + mirrored Discussion corpus | **② restore caller — with one unverified premise.** I did not confirm the mirrored corpus is still Engine-owned; if it moved, this becomes ① or ③ |
| 12 | `tree-json-lint` | `lint-tree-json.mjs` — **ABSENT everywhere** | `learn/tree.json`, `apps/portal/llms.txt`, `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` | **③ RESTORE the producer.** `learn/tree.json` exists in the Engine today and no successor guards it |
| 13 | `skill-manifest-lint` | `lint-skill-manifest.mjs` **ABSENT**; `lint-agents.mjs` alive — Brain | `.agents/skills/skills.manifest.json`, `SKILL.md`, **and** `AGENTS.md` + `learn/agentos/` | **③ SPLIT — see below.** Not one disposition |

### Row 13 is why your rule 4 earns its place

That workflow invoked **two** producers, and they now have opposite dispositions. Retiring or restoring it as a unit is wrong either way:

- **`lint-skill-manifest.mjs` → retire in the Engine.** Its target left the repository: `.agents/skills` here is a **symlink into `node_modules/neo-agent-skills`** and `git ls-files .agents/skills` returns **nothing**. Restoring an Engine caller would guard a symlink into a dependency. The guarded property is already satisfied in the right repo — Skills' `skill-corpus` job reports `37 skills, coherent with the manifest`. Successor, not restore.
- **`lint-agents.mjs` → restore, and it is currently unguarded everywhere.** It guards `AGENTS.md`, `.agents/ANTIGRAVITY`, `learn/agentos/` and `learn/agentos/decisions/` — Engine-owned, all still here. The producer survives in the Brain and **no workflow in any repository calls it**: `git grep -l lint-agents origin/dev -- .github` returns nothing in the Brain, and it is one of the thirteen here.

So the honest count is **13 workflows / 14 producers**, and a wholesale retire of row 13 would have silently dropped the `AGENTS.md` guard — the exact "renamed/superseding contract must satisfy the original guarded property" failure your rule 4 names, arriving from the retire side rather than the restore side.

Worth noting alongside it: `AGENTS.md` in this repo currently sits at **24,574 of a 24,576-byte** substrate ceiling. Whether that is what `lint-agents.mjs` measures I have not checked, but the guard for that file class is the one nobody is running.

### Category totals

- **① successor / already routed:** 4 (rows 1–4) — no Engine restoration; consume the named owner.
- **② restore the `pin-fetch` caller, producer alive:** 7 (rows 5–11, plus `lint-agents` from row 13) — each needs the caller-visible red control you specified.
- **③ producer absent, decide:** 2 — row 12 **restore** (live Engine target, no successor), row 13's `lint-skill-manifest` **retire** (target left the repo, successor exists).

### What I have not established

- Row 11's mirrored-corpus custody.
- Whether any row's guarded property drifted since the cut such that restoring the caller would red immediately on unrelated grounds — the shape you already found on row 4. Rows 5–10 were not exercised; I resolved producers and targets, not runs.
- Which of rows 5–11 should become Skills-baseline jobs rather than Engine-local `pin-fetch` callers. Each guards Engine-owned content, which argues for `pin-fetch`, but that is a judgment on your surface and #14's, not a measurement.

Census scripts re-runnable against the SHAs named above.
